    Interface NormalizedPointerEvent

    A DOM pointer/wheel event normalized to element-local coords + modifiers.

    Example

    Runnable example association: geoparquet-viewer.

    interface NormalizedPointerEvent {
        button: number;
        kind:
            | "move"
            | "down"
            | "up"
            | "wheel"
            | "click"
            | "contextmenu"
            | "dblclick";
        modifiers: PointerModifiers;
        originalEvent: Event;
        point: { x: number; y: number };
        wheelDirection?: number;
    }
